hypotheses.justification: FiniteDimensional abbreviates Module.Finite. The remaining hypotheses imply it by Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite ℚ_[p] K L. Install this as a local instance and reuse the existing proof. The lemma has no nonzero-dimension exception.

The remaining Algebra ℚ_[p] L gives an injective algebra map between fields, and ℚ_[p] has characteristic zero. Thus charZero_of_injective_algebraMap reconstructs CharZero L locally, after which the existing proof applies. Fields exclude the trivial-target exception.

Similarly, Algebra ℚ_[p] K and injectivity of the algebra map between fields give CharZero K by charZero_of_injective_algebraMap. Install it locally and reuse the proof. There is no trivial-field exception; both characteristic-zero hypotheses can also be deleted together.
